meta.title: Olve.Trains — Architecture
meta.summary: On Track To Grow — a train-logistics city-builder on a bespoke C# OpenGL engine. Olve.Engine3D provides rendering, scenes, GUI and command infrastructure; Olve.Trains builds the simulation (tracks, trains, cargo, industries) and its presentation on top; an asset pipeline code-generates shader/layout types and Olve.Pipelines runs CD.

tooling.label: Commands, Pipeline & CI
tooling.summary: The tooling layer covers the in-game command interface (verb-based handlers that query and mutate game state and emit JSON), the asset pipeline that compiles shaders/layouts/meshes/textures/terrains/fonts/atlases into binary assets and generated C# via Scriban templates, and the GitOps CD pipeline (Olve.Pipelines) that builds Linux+Windows, screenshot-tests, and publishes to S3 and itch.io. Command handlers deliver the observability contract (list-/query- per entity), the pipeline feeds generated code into the game build, and CI gates every publish on the integration test suite.

engine-core.label: Engine Core
engine-core.summary: The foundational engine infrastructure in Olve.Engine3D: a scene system that orchestrates prioritized scene services through a load/activate/update/render lifecycle, an event system (Event<T>/EventQueue bridged into scene lifecycle), a detached-mode command system over named pipes, input schemes, time stepping (windowed and manual/deterministic), entity storage with indexes, spline interpolation, and collision/raycast physics. Almost all gameplay and rendering features are composed as scene services over these primitives.

engine-gui.label: GUI System
engine-gui.summary: A retained-mode, tree-based GUI toolkit in Olve.Engine3D. Element trees (Box/Text/Image plus interactive widgets) are registered against screen or element-relative anchors, then a flexbox-style layout service computes density-independent positions consumed by collision/hit-testing, mouse input, focus/activation, state-driven styling, and time-based animation. Text is laid out from MSDF font atlases.

engine-rendering.label: Rendering Pipeline
engine-rendering.summary: The unified GPU rendering pipeline of Olve.Engine3D. All 2D and 3D drawing flows through a single always-instanced RenderingManager backed by geometry, group, and instance managers, executed across ordered render passes into framebuffers. Supporting subsystems provide camera matrices, daylight/lighting curves, mesh/texture/shader asset management, and a thin typed OpenGL handle layer.

game-logic.label: Game Logic
game-logic.summary: The simulation/domain layer of Olve.Trains, registered as scene services for SceneIds.GameLogicScene. It models the playable world: terrain and grid, placeable tracks and junctions with signal routing, trains and wagons that move along track splines, buildings that specialize into stations/depots/industries/residences, and the cargo economy where resources feed industries and cargo flows through stations onto trains. Domains communicate largely through events (OnBuildingAdded, OnTrackAdded, OnTrainReachedTrackEnd, etc.) wired in GameLogicSceneServiceRegistration.

game-presentation.label: Presentation & Shell
game-presentation.summary: The presentation layer turns game-logic state into pixels and player interaction. Rendering services in the GameRendering scene subscribe to game-logic entity events (tracks, trains, wagons, buildings, environmental objects) and push instances into the engine's rendering managers, dual-registering shadow casters via the ShadowMapService. The GameUI scene layers in-world indicators, raycast-driven placement/deletion tools coordinated by a single-active-tool manager, and GUI panels; MainMenu, Loading, and a Shared GUI/rendering/telemetry foundation provide the surrounding app shell and bootstrap.

overview.label: Solution Overview
overview.summary: Olve.Trains is the C# (.NET 10) codebase for 'On Track To Grow', a train-network building game. It is organized as a small custom OpenGL engine (Olve.Engine3D) providing rendering, GUI and core utilities, a game application (Olve.Trains) that builds game logic and presentation on top of the engine and exposes a command/replay interface, and an offline asset pipeline (Olve.Trains.AssetPipeline) that compiles shaders, layouts, meshes, textures and fonts into generated code. External dependencies cluster around Silk.NET (rendering/windowing/input/Assimp), MemoryPack (serialization), the Olve.* utility packages, Scriban (asset code-gen templating), and TUnit (testing).

nodes.label: CommandHandlerService
nodes.summary: Abstract base for all command handlers: defines Verb, HelpString, Arguments, and Handle(CommandContext) returning Result<CommandOutput>.

nodes.label: load-scene
nodes.summary: Loads a named scene; entry point for replay/test setup.

nodes.label: place-track
nodes.summary: Mutates: places a track segment between two endpoints (with optional directions) via TrackPlacingService; logs and returns trackIds JSON.

nodes.label: place-building
nodes.summary: Mutates: places a building/station at a position.

nodes.label: place-train
nodes.summary: Mutates: spawns a train on a track.

nodes.label: delete-track / delete-train / delete-object
nodes.summary: Mutates: removes tracks, trains, or environmental objects by id.

nodes.label: add-wagon / remove-wagon / set-wagon-filter
nodes.summary: Mutates: manages a train's wagon consist and per-wagon cargo filters.

nodes.label: add-signal-rule / clear-signal-rules
nodes.summary: Mutates: configures junction signal routing rules.

nodes.label: set-time / set-speed / set-train-speed
nodes.summary: Mutates: controls simulation clock, global time scale, and individual train target speed.

nodes.label: click / set-mouse
nodes.summary: Mutates: drives synthetic mouse position and clicks for UI/world interaction.

nodes.label: list-<entity>
nodes.summary: Queries: list-tracks / -trains / -wagons / -buildings / -cities / -junctions / -entities — full entity collections as JSON (observability contract).

nodes.label: query-<entity>
nodes.summary: Queries: query-track / -train / -building / -city / -junction / -money / -time — single-entity or scalar state as JSON (observability contract).

nodes.label: raycast / project-to-screen
nodes.summary: Queries: world-ray hit testing and 3D-to-screen projection for test assertions.

nodes.label: toggle-collider-debug
nodes.summary: GameRendering command: toggles collider debug overlay rendering.

nodes.label: RunAssetPipeline
nodes.summary: Pipeline orchestrator: runs Layouts, S3 fetch, Shaders, then ProcessAssets in order, gated by BuildTargets flags.

nodes.label: BuildTargets
nodes.summary: Flags enum (Shaders/Meshes/Textures/Terrains/Layouts/Fonts/TextureAtlases) selecting which stages run; some require S3.

nodes.label: ProcessLayouts
nodes.summary: Parses XML UI layouts into generated C# element-tree classes (assets/Layouts/*.cs).

nodes.label: DownloadAssets / LoadLocalAssets
nodes.summary: Fetches S3-backed source assets (or loads local cache when S3:UseLocalAssets) for the S3-requiring targets.

nodes.label: ProcessShaders
nodes.summary: Compiles GLSL programs, extracts uniforms + vertex/instance attributes, generates typed C# shader classes.

nodes.label: ProcessAssets
nodes.summary: Dispatcher that runs the mesh/texture/terrain/atlas/font sub-processors based on enabled targets.

nodes.label: ProcessMeshAssets
nodes.summary: Reads/normalizes 3D model files into binary .mesh assets + generated C# (assets/Meshes).

nodes.label: ProcessTextureAssets
nodes.summary: Converts image files into binary .texture assets + generated C# (assets/Textures).

nodes.label: ProcessTerrainAssets
nodes.summary: Parses OpenRaster heightmap layers into binary .terrain assets + generated C# (assets/Terrains).

nodes.label: ProcessTextureAtlasAssets
nodes.summary: Packs textures into atlases and generates C# atlas-region accessor classes.

nodes.label: ProcessFonts
nodes.summary: Generates MSDF font atlases (written as RGB .texture) + binary font assets + generated C#.

nodes.label: AssetWriter / TemplateWriter
nodes.summary: Writes binary assets and renders Scriban templates into generated C# source files.

nodes.label: ShaderClass.scriban
nodes.summary: Scriban template emitting typed shader C# (uniforms, vertex/instance attribute structs, embedded source).

nodes.label: LayoutClass.scriban
nodes.summary: Scriban template emitting layout C# that builds the GUI element tree.

nodes.label: AssetClass / FontClass / TextureAtlasClass.scriban
nodes.summary: Scriban templates emitting C# accessor classes for mesh/texture/terrain assets, fonts, and texture atlases.

nodes.label: S3Options config
nodes.summary: S3 bucket/prefix/key/secret/timeout config; CI injects S3__Key/S3__Secret, bucket/prefix from appsettings.json.

nodes.label: Olve.Pipelines config.yaml
nodes.summary: GitOps CD spec: one parallel build production step, then sequential test -> publish-s3 -> publish-itch processing steps; push to master deploys.

nodes.label: build (Linux + Windows)
nodes.summary: Production step: runs asset pipeline once, then dotnet publish self-contained linux-x64 (.tar.gz) and win-x64 (.zip).

nodes.label: test (screenshot gate)
nodes.summary: Processing step: builds Release, runs the xvfb pytest integration suite; on failure exports diff PNGs to S3. Gates both publishes.

nodes.label: publish-s3
nodes.summary: Processing step: archives release artifacts to the olve-trains-dist S3 bucket (idempotently created), logs presigned URLs.

nodes.label: publish-itch
nodes.summary: Processing step: pushes linux + windows builds to itch.io (cookiscuit/on-track-to-grow) via butler.

nodes.label: Integration tests (pytest)
nodes.summary: pytest scenarios drive the game over a command pipe and compare screenshots against per-platform references (track loop, cargo, signals, panels, etc.).

nodes.label: Olve.Engine3D.Tests (TUnit)
nodes.summary: Unit tests for engine primitives — layout, splines, GUI widgets (dropdown, slider, checkbox, radio).

nodes.label: ISceneService
nodes.summary: Unit of scene behavior with Priority and optional Load/Unload/Input/Update/Render lifecycle hooks, each returning a Result.

nodes.label: Scene
nodes.summary: Sealed IScene holding services sorted by Priority; runs Input/Update/Render over them, re-checking State==Active between services so a mid-iteration unload skips the rest.

nodes.label: SceneManager
nodes.summary: Loads/unloads/activates scenes by Id, walking parent chain parent-first; root scenes create a DI scope, children reuse the parent's; orders by LayerOrder for Input/Update/Render and records per-scene metrics.

nodes.label: SceneDefinition
nodes.summary: Record describing a scene: Id<IScene>, Name, LayerOrder, optional ParentId for the hierarchy.

nodes.label: SceneState / Pass
nodes.summary: SceneState (Unloaded/Inactive/Active) drives lifecycle guards; Pass (Pass/Block) lets an input service stop propagation to lower layers.

nodes.label: SceneServiceRegistration
nodes.summary: DI extension methods (AddSceneService, AddEventSceneService, AddImmediateEventSceneService, AddSceneParameterService) that register keyed scoped services per scene Id and resolve priority from after/before dependency hints.

nodes.label: SceneServicePriority
nodes.summary: Helper computing a service priority FromDependencies (max+Step) or FromDependents (min-Step) to order ordering within a scene.

nodes.label: SceneScopeAccessor
nodes.summary: Tracks active scenes' DI service providers so cross-cutting code can resolve from currently-active scene scopes.

nodes.label: Event / Event<T>
nodes.summary: Lightweight multicast pub/sub wrapper over a delegate with Subscribe/Unsubscribe/Invoke; the building block for all engine events and EntityStore notifications.

nodes.label: EventQueue<T>
nodes.summary: Subscribes to an Event<T>, buffers invocations into a ConcurrentQueue, and drains them through a handler on Update (deferred, thread-safe delivery); supports prefill.

nodes.label: EventSceneService<T>
nodes.summary: Scene service bridging deferred events to lifecycle: Init/subscribe the EventQueue on Load, drain it on Update, Cleanup/unsubscribe on Unload.

nodes.label: ImmediateEventSceneService<T>
nodes.summary: Scene service that subscribes a handler directly to an Event<T> on Load (synchronous, no queue), runs prefill, and unsubscribes on Unload.

nodes.label: ICommandHandler
nodes.summary: Command contract: Verb, HelpString, Arguments, and Handle(CommandContext) returning Result<CommandOutput>. Implementations include echo/exit/help/log/screenshot/step.

nodes.label: CommandRunner
nodes.summary: Parses a command line, finds the handler by Verb in CommandHandlerServiceCollection, validates arguments, and invokes Handle (supporting repeat count).

nodes.label: CommandHandlerServiceCollection
nodes.summary: Mutable registry (HashSet) of ICommandHandler instances that scene services add/remove; the runner enumerates it to resolve verbs.

nodes.label: CommandPipeServer
nodes.summary: Background named-pipe server (olve-trains-{instance}) on its own task; reads length-prefixed MemoryPack CommandRequests, enqueues them with a TaskCompletionSource, and writes back the CommandResponse.

nodes.label: CommandQueue
nodes.summary: Thread-safe ConcurrentQueue of PendingCommand (command + TaskCompletionSource): pipe thread enqueues, main thread dequeues to keep command execution on the game loop.

nodes.label: CommandProcessingService
nodes.summary: Scene service (priority -1000) that drains the CommandQueue each Update tick, runs each via CommandRunner, and completes the TaskCompletionSource with a CommandResponse.

nodes.label: GameInstanceId
nodes.summary: Identifies the instance and derives the pipe name (olve-trains-{id}) used by the pipe server/client.

nodes.label: ITimeStepper
nodes.summary: Drives the loop, exposing Load/Update/Render/Closing events. WindowStepper binds Silk.NET window callbacks; ManualStepper steps deterministically, processing commands and advancing frames on demand for tests/replays.

nodes.label: DeltaTimeService
nodes.summary: Holds RawDeltaTime, TimeScale and derived ScaledDeltaTime; set each frame before services run so consumers read scaled time.

nodes.label: DayTimeManager
nodes.summary: Tracks in-game time of day from accumulated game hours over a configurable DayLength; Step advances time, fires OnDayStart per day boundary, and exposes absolute day/hour/minute counts.

nodes.label: KeyboardManager
nodes.summary: Subscribes to Silk.NET keyboards, buffers pressed/released keys, and snapshots them into KeyboardState each Input phase. MouseManager mirrors this for mouse.

nodes.label: ICameraScheme
nodes.summary: Maps raw input to CameraMovementInput (direction/rotation/zoom). Implementations: WasdMovement (keyboard) and MouseLook.

nodes.label: EntityStore<T>
nodes.summary: Composition-pattern store over IdDictionary<T> with TryAdd/Set/Remove/TryGet/Exists/Where and OnAdded/OnRemoved events; services compose it and expose domain-named events. Spawns indexes.

nodes.label: IdDictionary<T>
nodes.summary: Dictionary keyed by Id<T> for entities implementing IHasId<Id<T>>; the backing storage for EntityStore.

nodes.label: EntityStoreIndex / UniqueIndex
nodes.summary: Secondary index over an EntityStore maintained live via OnAdded/OnRemoved subscriptions, mapping a key selector to entity Ids (set-valued or unique).

nodes.label: BoundedContainer<TKey>
nodes.summary: Capacity-limited per-key integer container with optional per-key limits and exact/within-capacity update modes; used for inventory-style storage.

nodes.label: CollisionSystem
nodes.summary: Registry of colliders (shape + group + world matrix + cached world AABB) supporting register/update/unregister with events, broad-phase AABB + narrow-phase shape raycasts, and AABB overlap queries.

nodes.label: IColliderShape
nodes.summary: Collider geometry contract: GetWorldAABB and TryRaycast. Implementations BoxColliderShape and HeightmapColliderShape (terrain, via HeightmapRaycaster).

nodes.label: AABB
nodes.summary: Axis-aligned bounding box with intersection and ray-intersection helpers; core to broad-phase collision and GUI hit testing.

nodes.label: IInterpolator<T>
nodes.summary: Spline/curve interpolation contract (Sample/Tangent over [Min,Max]). Implementations: CatmullRom, Hermite/UniformHermite, Linear, and None — used for camera/animation and track curves.

nodes.label: Provider<T>
nodes.summary: Late-initialized holder for engine singletons (IWindow, GL, IInputContext): throws NotInitializedException until Set, disposes the value if disposable.

nodes.label: EngineMetrics
nodes.summary: Static System.Diagnostics.Metrics meter exposing frame/update/render/input durations, active-scene count, and commands-processed; IsEnabled gates Stopwatch timing.

nodes.label: Engine Events
nodes.summary: Concrete engine-level event sources: ScreenResizedEvent (window resize), GameClosingEvent (shutdown), AfterRenderEvent — each wrapping an Event<T> fired by the time stepper.

nodes.label: GuiElement
nodes.summary: Abstract base for all UI elements: Id, Name, Children, StyleKey, Interactive/InheritParentState flags, optional LayoutBox.

nodes.label: Box
nodes.summary: Flexbox container element: width/height/weight/gap/margin/padding, Justify/Align, Vertical axis, background, border, radius, aspect ratio. Implements IRenderableAsRectangle.

nodes.label: Text
nodes.summary: Auto-sized text element: content, font, font size/weight, color, align; caches a ComputedSize. Implements IRenderableAsText + IRenderableAsRectangle.

nodes.label: Image
nodes.summary: Texture-display element: AssetPath texture, tint, alpha, aspect ratio, fit mode, optional source-rect/atlas UVs. Implements IRenderableAsRectangle.

nodes.label: Interactive Widgets
nodes.summary: Composite interactive elements (Checkbox, Slider, RadioButton/RadioButtonGroup, Dropdown, Divider) each backed by a dedicated scene service.

nodes.label: Widget Services
nodes.summary: Scene services driving widget behaviour/state: GuiSliderService, GuiCheckboxService, GuiRadioButtonService, GuiDropdownService. Each emits value-changed events.

nodes.label: GuiNode
nodes.summary: Runtime tree node (Id + Name) created per registered element; the unit layout/state/depth/collision key off.

nodes.label: GuiNodeService
nodes.summary: Owns the GuiNode hierarchy (parent/children, anchor roots, enabled flags); cascading add/remove, ancestor/descendant traversal with cycle detection, OnNodeAdded/Removed events.

nodes.label: GuiElementService
nodes.summary: Registers element trees under an anchor/node, maintaining a bi-map between (registration, element id) and GuiNode; recursive register/unregister, lookups, OnAdded/OnRemoved events.

nodes.label: GuiAnchor
nodes.summary: Anchor record: AnchorPosition, GrowthDirection, depth, optional reference node (for element-relative anchoring).

nodes.label: GuiAnchorService
nodes.summary: Registers/updates/unregisters screen and element-relative anchors that GUI element trees attach to as roots.

nodes.label: LayoutBox / SizeSpec
nodes.summary: Immutable layout spec per element: SizeSpec (preferred w/h, resizing weight, aspect ratio, fit mode), padding/margin/border chrome, gap, align/justify, layout axis.

nodes.label: GuiLayoutService
nodes.summary: Core flexbox layout engine. Computes ghost boxes from anchors, preferred/actual sizes (aspect-ratio + equalized space distribution), and recursive child positions in Dp; converts to Px on query. Tracks dirty state via node add/remove.

nodes.label: GuiLayoutUpdateService
nodes.summary: Scene service that drains element add/remove event queues, pushes each element's LayoutBox into GuiLayoutService, and triggers ComputeLayout each frame.

nodes.label: LayoutContext / Dp
nodes.summary: Density-independent unit (Dp) plus design-size/Dp-to-Px conversion context used throughout layout to stay resolution-independent.

nodes.label: GuiDepthService
nodes.summary: Computes per-node integer depth (anchor depth as base, +1 per nesting level) used to resolve topmost element during hit-testing and draw order.

nodes.label: GuiCollisionService
nodes.summary: AABB hit-testing: returns all GuiNodes whose computed BoxPosition contains a given Px point.

nodes.label: GuiMouseInputService
nodes.summary: Input scene service (priority -100). Resolves topmost interactive node under the cursor via collision+depth, sets focus, tracks press/release, fires activation on same-node release, and blocks input passthrough while pressed.

nodes.label: GuiFocusService
nodes.summary: Tracks the single focused (hovered) node; emits OnFocusChanged(previous, next).

nodes.label: GuiActivationService
nodes.summary: Emits GuiElementActivated(NodeId) when an enabled node is clicked; the canonical button-click signal for panel services.

nodes.label: GuiNodeState
nodes.summary: Flags enum of interaction states: Show, Enabled, Focused (hover), Pressed, Active (toggled).

nodes.label: GuiNodeStateService
nodes.summary: Per-node interaction-state registry; setting/updating a node's state also propagates to children flagged InheritParentState and emits OnStateChanged(before, after).

nodes.label: GuiElementStyling / StyleKey
nodes.summary: Typed style definition (GuiElementStyling<T> : IGuiElementStyling): a StyleKey, optional OnStateChanged callback receiving StateWeights, and per-state transition config.

nodes.label: GuiStyleRegistry
nodes.summary: Singleton registry mapping StyleKey to IGuiElementStyling; resolves the style for a given element.

nodes.label: GuiStyleApplierService
nodes.summary: Applies animated StateWeights to an element via its style's OnStateChanged callback, then re-pushes the (possibly resized) LayoutBox to the layout service.

nodes.label: GuiAnimationService
nodes.summary: Scene service that turns node state changes into time-based weight animations (in/out per flag, easing + duration via StateTransition), emitting GuiStateWeightsChanged each frame.

nodes.label: Easing / EasingFunctions
nodes.summary: Easing enum (Linear, EaseIn, EaseOut, EaseInOut) and the functions that compute an animation weight from normalized time.

nodes.label: TextLayoutEngine
nodes.summary: Static helper computing per-glyph positions and atlas UVs from MSDF FontData (PlaneBounds/AtlasBounds, em scaling) and measuring text size in Px.

nodes.label: IRenderableAsRectangle / IRenderableAsText
nodes.summary: Render-data contracts elements expose (rectangle color/border/UVs, text render data) for the Trains-layer GUI rendering services to consume.

nodes.label: GuiServiceRegistration
nodes.summary: DI wiring (AddGuiServices) that registers all GUI services, the singleton style registry, and the widget services.

nodes.label: RenderingManager
nodes.summary: Top-level orchestrator; RenderAll() iterates ordered passes, binds framebuffers, rebuilds dirty instance buffers, applies render state, loads shaders, issues instanced draw calls, then blits to screen.

nodes.label: RenderingManagerSceneService
nodes.summary: ISceneService (Priority int.MaxValue) that calls RenderingManager.RenderAll() once per frame after all other rendering services.

nodes.label: GeometryManager
nodes.summary: Registers/updates/deregisters mesh geometry (VBO + optional EBO) keyed by GeometryId; supports indexed and DrawArrays geometry; marshals vertex data to floats.

nodes.label: RenderingGroupManager
nodes.summary: Groups = geometry + shader + render state + render pass; builds the VAO and instance VBO, configures vertex/instance attributes, and indexes groups by pass sorted by sortKey.

nodes.label: RenderingInstanceManager
nodes.summary: Adds/updates/removes per-instance data within a group's InstanceStore and marks the group dirty for buffer rebuild.

nodes.label: InstanceStore
nodes.summary: Typed store of instances within a group; marshals instances to a flat float buffer for upload as the instance VBO.

nodes.label: RenderPassManager
nodes.summary: Creates/destroys render passes (framebuffer + priority + clear flags + clear color) and returns them ordered by priority for RenderAll to iterate.

nodes.label: FramebufferManager
nodes.summary: Allocates FBOs with typed color/depth attachments (1-3 color targets + optional depth), resizes/deletes them, and exposes attachment texture handles for sampling.

nodes.label: ScreenPassManager
nodes.summary: Holds the final source framebuffer/color texture and blits it to the default framebuffer (screen) at the end of RenderAll.

nodes.label: IFrameFormat
nodes.summary: Marker interfaces (0-3 typed color pixel formats) that type framebuffers, render passes, and shaders to a compatible attachment layout at compile time.

nodes.label: RenderState
nodes.summary: record struct(BlendMode, DepthWrite, DepthTest) with presets (Opaque, AlphaBlend, AlphaBlendNoDepthWrite, ...); Apply(gl) configures GL blend/depth state per group.

nodes.label: IShader
nodes.summary: Shader abstraction: carries ShaderData + RenderingId, exposes MakeParameters() (uniforms). Generic IShader<TFormat> ties a shader to a frame format. Concrete shaders are generated by the asset pipeline.

nodes.label: ShaderEntityManager
nodes.summary: Engine-side registry mapping RenderingId<ShaderData> to compiled OpenGL shader registrations; delegates compilation/linking to OpenGLShaderManager.

nodes.label: OpenGLShaderManager
nodes.summary: Compiles/links GLSL (vertex, fragment, optional geometry) into ShaderProgram, resolves world/normalMatrix uniform locations, and loads/applies RenderingParameters as uniforms.

nodes.label: RenderingParameters
nodes.summary: Collection of typed uniform parameters (matrices, vectors, samplers) each able to SetUniforms on a bound ShaderProgram; produced by IShader.MakeParameters and per-group overrides.

nodes.label: IVertexData
nodes.summary: Vertex data contract: FloatCount, WriteTo(Span<float>), static ConfigureAttributes(GL). Implemented by generated per-shader Vertex records via composable IWith*<T> attribute interfaces.

nodes.label: IInstanceData
nodes.summary: Per-instance data contract (typed IInstanceData<TVertex>) mirroring IVertexData but with VertexAttribDivisor(1). All shaders are always-instanced.

nodes.label: GeometryId / GroupId / RenderingId
nodes.summary: Type-safe ID wrappers: GeometryId<TVertex>, GroupId<TInstance>, and RenderingId<TEntity> prevent mixing geometry/instance/entity types at compile time.

nodes.label: UnitCube / UnitQuad
nodes.summary: Generic primitive geometry: UnitCube (24 verts/36 indices, Populate<T> with position+normal) and UnitQuad (6 verts, 2D position) for GUI. Generic over any IWith* vertex type.

nodes.label: GL Handles (VAO/VBO/EBO/ShaderProgram/Texture2D)
nodes.summary: Thin typed wrappers around raw OpenGL object handles used throughout the rendering layer.

nodes.label: TextureManager
nodes.summary: Singleton CPU-side registry of typed TextureData keyed by TextureId<T>; raises OnAdded/OnRemoved events consumed by the OpenGL upload path.

nodes.label: TextureEntityManager
nodes.summary: Bridges CPU TextureData to GPU Texture2D registrations via OpenGLTextureManager; also registers externally created handles (e.g. framebuffer attachments) for sampling.

nodes.label: OpenGLTextureManager
nodes.summary: Uploads pixel data to GL textures with format/upload options, producing Texture2D handles.

nodes.label: TextureSlotManager
nodes.summary: Binds textures to GL texture units (max 8) via a rotating index so sampler uniforms can reference them during shader parameter application.

nodes.label: IPixelFormat
nodes.summary: Pixel format descriptors (RGBA, RGB, R32F, Rg32f, Depth, DepthStencil) mapping unmanaged pixel types to GL internal/pixel formats for textures and attachments.

nodes.label: MeshManager
nodes.summary: Singleton CPU registry of MeshData keyed by Id<Mesh>; computes and caches each mesh's local AABB and raises OnAdded/OnRemoved events.

nodes.label: MeshLoadingManager
nodes.summary: Loads mesh assets (via AssetLoader) and registers their MeshData with MeshManager.

nodes.label: MeshData / ShaderData / TextureData
nodes.summary: Behavior-free asset data records: MeshData (vertices/indices), ShaderData (GLSL sources + name), TextureData<T> (typed pixels). Consumed by the managers above.

nodes.label: Camera
nodes.summary: Generic Camera<TView,TProjection> implementing ICamera; composes a view and projection to produce view and projection matrices fed to shaders as uniforms.

nodes.label: IView
nodes.summary: View abstraction producing the view matrix from position/rotation. Implementations: FirstPersonView, IsometricView, OrbitalView (ViewBase).

nodes.label: IProjection
nodes.summary: Projection abstraction producing the projection matrix (aspect/near/far). Implementations: PerspectiveProjection, OrthographicProjection (ProjectionBase).

nodes.label: ICameraController
nodes.summary: Drives camera Move/Rotate/Zoom over time. Implementations include PerspectiveCameraController and isometric ortho/perspective controllers (CameraControllerBase).

nodes.label: DaylightManager
nodes.summary: Manages directional daylight lights as time-of-day curves (angle, color, intensity, ambient); samples interpolated DaylightValue per DayTime for lighting uniforms.

nodes.label: GameLogicSceneServiceRegistration
nodes.summary: Registers all game-logic services and event wiring for the GameLogic scene.

nodes.label: WorldScale
nodes.summary: Constants converting between tiles, meters and game units (TileSizeInMeters = 50).

nodes.label: Track
nodes.summary: Record struct: Id plus Start/End TrackEndpoints defining a Hermite-spline segment.

nodes.label: TrackService
nodes.summary: Central track registry; Add/Delete tracks, emits OnTrackAdded/OnTrackRemoved.

nodes.label: TrackSplineService
nodes.summary: Builds/caches Hermite splines per track; provides position, tangent and length queries.

nodes.label: TrackConnectionService
nodes.summary: Determines which tracks connect through junctions by tangent alignment.

nodes.label: TrackCollisionService
nodes.summary: Registers sampled track segments as OBB colliders in the collision system.

nodes.label: TrackValidationService
nodes.summary: Validates track placement via curvature and collision checks.

nodes.label: TrackPlacingService
nodes.summary: Player-facing track placement; charges money and delegates to TrackService.

nodes.label: Junction
nodes.summary: Record struct: Id and TilePosition aggregating track endpoints at a tile.

nodes.label: JunctionSignalRule
nodes.summary: Routing rule: trains, source/destination matchers and distribution strategy.

nodes.label: JunctionService
nodes.summary: Registry of junctions by tile; tracks connections, emits OnJunctionConnectionsUpdated.

nodes.label: JunctionSignalService
nodes.summary: Tracks junctions with signals (>=3 connections); emits OnJunctionAdded/Removed.

nodes.label: JunctionSignalRuleService
nodes.summary: Maintains signal rules per junction; auto-creates default RoundRobin rule.

nodes.label: JunctionSignalRuleEvaluationService
nodes.summary: Evaluates rules against a train to choose the next track at a junction.

nodes.label: JunctionSignalCollisionService
nodes.summary: Registers signal meshes as colliders for picking.

nodes.label: Train

nodes.label: TrainPositionService
nodes.summary: Stores per-train TrackPosition and TrainMotion state.

nodes.label: TrainMovementService
nodes.summary: Per-frame physics: accelerates and advances spline time; emits OnTrainReachedTrackEnd.

nodes.label: TrainJunctionService
nodes.summary: Queries junction presence and track endpoints around a train.

nodes.label: TrainJunctionCrossingService
nodes.summary: On reaching a track end, evaluates signal rules and transfers train to next track.

nodes.label: TrainTrackHistoryService
nodes.summary: Circular buffer of recently traversed tracks per train for wagon spanning.

nodes.label: TrainGroupService
nodes.summary: Many-to-many membership of trains in groups, used by signal rules.

nodes.label: TrainCollisionService
nodes.summary: Registers/updates a box collider per train sampled from the spline.

nodes.label: Wagon
nodes.summary: Record struct (Id, BlueprintId); attached to a train, derives position from it.

nodes.label: WagonBlueprint
nodes.summary: Capacity, length and optional allowed cargo types for a wagon.

nodes.label: TrainWagonService
nodes.summary: Owns wagon lists per train; AddWagon charges money, emits OnWagonAdded/Removed.

nodes.label: WagonInventoryService
nodes.summary: Creates a CargoInventory per wagon and applies type-filter policies.

nodes.label: WagonPositioningService
nodes.summary: Computes wagon positions by walking back from the locomotive along track history.

nodes.label: WagonBlueprintService
nodes.summary: Registry/lookup of wagon blueprints.

nodes.label: CargoType
nodes.summary: Cargo type identity (Id + name), e.g. Wood, Coal, Planks.

nodes.label: CargoInventory
nodes.summary: Inventory with capacity and optional allowed-types filter; canonical cargo holder.

nodes.label: IndustryRecipe
nodes.summary: Inputs, outputs and production interval defining an industry transformation.

nodes.label: CargoInventoryService
nodes.summary: Manages inventory state: add/remove, capacity checks, type filtering.

nodes.label: CargoTransferService
nodes.summary: Atomic multi-inventory transfers and recipe execution (validate then apply).

nodes.label: CargoTransferPolicyService
nodes.summary: Per-inventory In/Out/Both/None direction policies per cargo type.

nodes.label: CargoTypeService
nodes.summary: Cargo type registry.

nodes.label: CargoAndRecipeLibraryService
nodes.summary: Loads the cargo/recipe catalog at scene load (Wood/Coal/Planks; Forest/Mine/Sawmill).

nodes.label: StationCargoTransferService
nodes.summary: Orchestrates train<->building cargo exchange at stations using transfer policies.

nodes.label: Resource
nodes.summary: Record (Id, ResourceTypeId, EnvironmentalObjectId, position) representing a harvestable.

nodes.label: ResourceService
nodes.summary: Resource registry; maps environmental objects (trees) to resources by type.

nodes.label: ResourceOwnershipService
nodes.summary: Computes harvest productivity for extractive industries from nearby resource density.

nodes.label: Industry
nodes.summary: Record (Id, BuildingId, RecipeId, InventoryId) specializing a building into a producer.

nodes.label: IndustryService
nodes.summary: Creates industries from building blueprints; sets up inventory and policies.

nodes.label: IndustryProductionService
nodes.summary: Per-tick production: primary produce unconditionally, secondary run recipes; scales extractive output by resource productivity.

nodes.label: Building
nodes.summary: Base placed entity (Id, BlueprintId, BuildingPosition) that specializes into other types.

nodes.label: BuildingBlueprint
nodes.summary: Blueprint metadata: description and tile footprint.

nodes.label: BuildingService
nodes.summary: Central building CRUD; emits OnBuildingAdded/OnBuildingRemoved driving specialization.

nodes.label: BuildingBlueprintService
nodes.summary: Stores building blueprints and attaches specialized properties; library loads at startup.

nodes.label: BuildingPositionService
nodes.summary: Computes world matrices from tile position and cardinal direction.

nodes.label: BuildingCollisionService
nodes.summary: Registers/unregisters building footprint colliders.

nodes.label: Station
nodes.summary: Specialized building linked to a track; train loading/unloading point.

nodes.label: StationService
nodes.summary: Creates Station entities on OnBuildingAdded for station blueprints; spawns tracks; generates names.

nodes.label: Depot
nodes.summary: Specialized building linked to a track; where trains are placed/stored.

nodes.label: DepotService
nodes.summary: Creates Depot entities on OnBuildingAdded for depot blueprints; spawns tracks.

nodes.label: City
nodes.summary: Owner of residences; holds a CargoInventory for city cargo demand.

nodes.label: CityService
nodes.summary: Creates Residence entities on OnBuildingAdded; owns cities and their inventories.

nodes.label: TerrainData / HeightmapData
nodes.summary: Heightmap grid of tile heights plus terrain metadata.

nodes.label: TerrainService
nodes.summary: Loads the heightmap, manages terrain state and spawns environmental objects.

nodes.label: GridService
nodes.summary: Converts between world coordinates and discrete tile positions.

nodes.label: EnvironmentalObject
nodes.summary: Decorative/harvestable world object (tree, rock, grass) with position and mesh.

nodes.label: EnvironmentalObjectService
nodes.summary: CRUD for environmental objects, indexed by blueprint; emits OnObjectAdded/Removed.

nodes.label: EnvironmentalObjectCollisionService
nodes.summary: Registers environmental objects as auto-clearable colliders.

nodes.label: PlacementClearanceService
nodes.summary: Clears overlapping environmental objects when buildings/tracks are placed (via collision queries).

nodes.label: CameraSceneService
nodes.summary: Isometric/orthographic camera; caches view/projection, handles WASD pan and zoom.

nodes.label: SceneLightService
nodes.summary: Samples sun/moon from day time to provide directional lights and ambient color.

nodes.label: MoneyService
nodes.summary: Tracks balance; charge/afford checks consulted before purchases.

nodes.label: DayTimeSteppingService
nodes.summary: Advances day time each frame; configurable day start and duration.

nodes.label: Program

nodes.label: GameServiceRegistration
nodes.summary: AddAllServices DI composition root: registers engine modules, singletons, command infra, all five scenes' services, and the SceneDefinition hierarchy.

nodes.label: SceneIds
nodes.summary: Static Id<IScene> identifiers for MainMenu, Loading, GameLogic, GameRendering and GameUI scenes.

nodes.label: GameRenderingSceneServiceRegistration
nodes.summary: Registers GameRendering scene services and wires game-logic entity add/remove events to renderer Register/Unregister handlers.

nodes.label: UISceneServiceRegistration
nodes.summary: Registers GameUI scene services: raycast, indicators, tools, GUI panels and screenshot service.

nodes.label: MainMenuSceneServiceRegistration
nodes.summary: Registers MainMenu scene: GL/rendering core, GUI services, command processing and the menu service.

nodes.label: LoadingSceneServiceRegistration
nodes.summary: Registers Loading scene: GL/rendering core, GUI, command processing, parameter service and loading service.

nodes.label: GuiSceneServiceRegistration
nodes.summary: Shared AddGuiSceneServices: registers Olve.Trains GUI rect/text services plus engine GUI layout/input/animation/state services and wires GUI state events.

nodes.label: GLService
nodes.summary: Engine bootstrap service: configures GL state, creates off-screen color+depth framebuffer and clear pass, handles window resize and clear color.

nodes.label: SharedRenderingService
nodes.summary: Creates and exposes the MainPass and GuiPass render passes used by all renderers; loaded early (priority -5).

nodes.label: ShadowMapService
nodes.summary: Manages the shadow framebuffer/pass and light-space matrix; renderers dual-register shadow groups/instances here so meshes cast shadows.

nodes.label: MeshRenderingService
nodes.summary: Shared mesh-instancing service: registers mesh groups/instances on MainPass and dual-registers them into ShadowMapService; used by all mesh renderers.

nodes.label: TerrainRenderingService
nodes.summary: Renders the terrain mesh with the Terrain shader, applying camera, light and shadow parameters; a priority anchor for other renderers.

nodes.label: TrackRenderingService
nodes.summary: Renders placed tracks as spline instances using the Track shader; Register/Unregister driven by TrackService add/remove events, dual-registered for shadows.

nodes.label: TrackGhostRenderingService
nodes.summary: Renders preview/ghost track centerlines as line strips on MainPass; driven externally by the track placement tool, no shadows.

nodes.label: TrackTemplateMeshService
nodes.summary: Static generator producing the rail-pair template mesh (vertices+indices) for a unit-length track segment.

nodes.label: TrainRenderingService
nodes.summary: Renders locomotive meshes (one instance per train) by sampling spline positions each frame; driven by TrainService add/remove events.

nodes.label: WagonRenderingService
nodes.summary: Renders wagon meshes (one instance per wagon) positioned along the track spline; driven by TrainWagonService add/remove events.

nodes.label: BuildingRenderingService
nodes.summary: Renders placed buildings as per-blueprint mesh instances plus type-colored footprint decals; driven by BuildingService add/remove events.

nodes.label: BuildingGhostPreviewService
nodes.summary: Renders the translucent building placement ghost (mesh + footprint), recoloring red when invalid; driven by the building placement tool.

nodes.label: FootprintRenderingService
nodes.summary: Low-level renderer for rounded-rect world-space footprint decals (WorldRectangle shader) on MainPass; no shadows.

nodes.label: ClearancePreviewService
nodes.summary: Highlights environmental objects that a build action would auto-clear by tinting them red via the environmental object renderer.

nodes.label: EnvironmentalObjectRenderingService
nodes.summary: Renders environmental objects (trees, rocks) as mesh instances grouped by mesh/texture with per-instance color override; driven by EnvironmentalObjectService events.

nodes.label: JunctionSignalRenderingService
nodes.summary: Renders crossing-light meshes at junctions that have signals, driven by junction signal add/remove events.

nodes.label: ColliderDebugRenderingService
nodes.summary: Debug overlay (F3) drawing wireframe AABB/OBB boxes for colliders, driven by CollisionSystem events; no shadows.

nodes.label: MouseRaycastService
nodes.summary: Builds a camera ray from the mouse each frame, raycasts the CollisionSystem and exposes Hits, terrain intersection and grid-snapped tile for tools/panels.

nodes.label: ToolManagementService
nodes.summary: Central tool registry enforcing a single active tool; fires ActiveToolChanged and provides name lookup for the select-tool command.

nodes.label: Tool
nodes.summary: Behavior-free record identifying a tool by Id<Tool> and Name.

nodes.label: BaseToolService
nodes.summary: Abstract tool base: self-registers its Tool, subscribes to ActiveToolChanged, and gates Input/Update/Render so only the active tool acts.

nodes.label: TrackPlacingToolService
nodes.summary: Two-click track placement tool; previews a ghost spline, direction arrow and clearance AABB, commits via TrackPlacingService.

nodes.label: BuildingPlacementToolService
nodes.summary: Shared (non-scene) building preview engine: validates position, drives the ghost/clearance previews and commits via BuildingService; reused by all building tools.

nodes.label: StationPlacingToolService
nodes.summary: Station placement tool delegating to BuildingPlacementToolService with the Station blueprint.

nodes.label: ResidencePlacingToolService
nodes.summary: Residence placement tool delegating to BuildingPlacementToolService with the Residential blueprint.

nodes.label: ForestPlacingToolService
nodes.summary: Forest placement tool delegating to BuildingPlacementToolService with the Forest blueprint.

nodes.label: SawmillPlacingToolService
nodes.summary: Sawmill placement tool delegating to BuildingPlacementToolService with the Sawmill blueprint.

nodes.label: DepotPlacingToolService
nodes.summary: Depot placement tool delegating to BuildingPlacementToolService with the Depot blueprint.

nodes.label: DeletionToolService
nodes.summary: Click-to-delete tool: inspects raycast hits' collider groups and routes deletion to the matching entity service (train/building/track/environment).

nodes.label: SelectToolHandlerService
nodes.summary: select-tool command handler mapping a tool name to ToolManagementService.SetActiveTool; the replay/command entry point for tool switching.

nodes.label: TrackArrowIndicatorService
nodes.summary: Renders instanced 3D direction arrows in the world (arrow mesh + Default shader) to show track placement direction.

nodes.label: ToolBarService
nodes.summary: Bottom toolbar mapping icon buttons to tools; toggles via ToolManagementService and reflects the active tool's button state.

nodes.label: InfoBarService
nodes.summary: Top info bar showing clock, money balance and FPS; opens the burger menu.

nodes.label: BurgerMenuService
nodes.summary: Modal in-game menu (Resume/Main Menu/Save/Load/Options) driving scene transitions via SceneManager.

nodes.label: DayTimeSliderService
nodes.summary: Panel with time-of-day, time-scale, pause and sky-color controls bound to DayTimeManager, DeltaTimeService and GLService clear color.

nodes.label: SignalRulesPanelService
nodes.summary: Raycast-driven junction signal panel for adding/clearing signal rules via JunctionSignalRuleService.

nodes.label: StationInfoPanelService
nodes.summary: Raycast-driven station panel listing cargo inventory rows for the selected station.

nodes.label: IndustryInfoPanelService
nodes.summary: Raycast-driven industry panel showing productivity and cargo inventory for the selected industry.

nodes.label: DepotPanelService
nodes.summary: Raycast-driven depot panel for train management: create/delete trains and add/remove wagons via TrainService/TrainWagonService.

nodes.label: TrainSpeedCycleService
nodes.summary: Left-click on a train cycles its target speed (0 / half / max) via TrainPositionService.

nodes.label: ActivateGuiHandlerService
nodes.summary: activate-gui command handler resolving a layout path to a node and invoking GuiActivationService.Activate (test/replay hook).

nodes.label: QueryGuiHandlerService
nodes.summary: query-gui command handler serializing a GUI node's state flags to JSON for observability.

nodes.label: GameStyleRegistration
nodes.summary: Static registrar (in GameStyleService.cs) that registers all GUI styles from Styles into the GuiStyleRegistry; called from Program.

nodes.label: MainMenuService

nodes.label: LoadingService
nodes.summary: Loading scene service: shows the loading screen, runs a background Task<GameSceneArguments> and auto-transitions to the game when complete.

nodes.label: LoadingSceneParameterService
nodes.summary: Scene parameter service receiving LoadingSceneArguments before the loading scene loads.

nodes.label: GuiRectangleRenderingService
nodes.summary: Shared GUI service rendering element rectangles/boxes on the GUI pass.

nodes.label: GuiTextRenderingService
nodes.summary: Shared GUI service rendering MSDF text glyphs on the GUI pass.

nodes.label: GuiLayoutContextUpdater
nodes.summary: Shared GUI service updating the layout context (screen size, scale) each frame for GUI layout.

nodes.summary: OpenTelemetry metrics (track/train/building counts) plus OTLP logging/metrics registration and OAuth2 token providers for observability.

nodes.summary: Train-network building game; the shipped product (AssemblyName 'On Track To Grow').

nodes.summary: Game application: scenes, game logic, presentation, GUI, command/replay interface and DI bootstrap.
